facts.fact: Government Notice No. 57, published 28 January 2025 under the Electronic and Postal Communications Act, amends the 2020 Online Content Regulations to add unethical, fabricated and AI-generated content (video, audio, still pictures) to prohibited online content, and obliges internet service providers and social media platform owners to filter and remove it.
